title: Subprime Lender PrimaLend’s Creditors Eye Bankruptcy Push

title: Trump's Plan to Rescue Argentina Is 'Unconventional,' Larry Summers Says

Summers warns about risks in fast-growing private credit, uneven deregulation, and a risky, go-it-alone US intervention to prop up Argentina’s peso without IMF-style safeguards. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: HDFC Bank’s Profit Tops Estimates Despite Margin Pressure

title: Funds Sue Lingerie Firm, Trustee in UK Over Soured Debt Deal

title: Wall Street Week | Japan Immigration, Race to Self-Driving Trucks, Defense & AI
content: This week, former US Treasury Secretary Lawrence H. Summers says that although bank profits are up, bigger risks are brewing in credit and in an unconventional US bet on Argentina’s currency. And, could Japan’s growing labor shortage finally make immigration a permanent part of its future? Plus, self-driving trucks promise to transform freight across the US and Europe, but the road to automation is not bump-free. Later, can artificial intelligence make war faster and safer without losing human control? (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Meloni Wins Italy’s Best Rating Since 2018 With DBRS Upgrade

title: US Auto Delinquencies Have Jumped 50% From 15 Years Ago

title: Rakuten Delivers Japan’s Highest-Yielding Yen Bond This Year
content: Rakuten Group Inc. priced a local bond at the year’s highest coupon of 4.691%, which helped build a strong order book driven particularly by overseas investors. The deal gave Japan’s credit market the clearest sign yet of the impact of rising government bond yields on corporate borrowing costs.
